entries.en: to diminish (the) punishments; to reduce penalties
to dissipate anger; to cease being angry
entries.notes: M 栏尾注 idemJo. 疑为「同上/参见」类旁记，不参与释义。

entries.en: to let go of resentment; to dissolve a grudge

entries.zh: 消脓；使脓消散（排脓去腐）
entries.en: to disperse or draw off pus (remove the morbid matter)
entries.notes: 汉字「消膿」与 M/R 对音一致；西语词头 quitando la mercería 与之不谐（疑为 materia 之讹读），释义以汉、音两栏为主。

entries.en: to shoot or discharge a crossbow
to bend or draw the bow (to shoot)
to fire an arquebus (hand-gun)
to fire the piece (cannon); to discharge a gun

entries.zh: 放炮；燃放爆竹焰火（亦指开炮）
entries.en: to set off firecrackers or rockets; to fire a cannon
to talk nonsense; confused, dazed
entries.notes: H 栏仅存单字「三」，其义不明（或为记音字）；据 M 栏 bōng、confuso 旁注及词头 Disparatar 定为糊涂乱说。

entries.zh: 谬；荒谬之言（说错话、说荒唐话）
entries.en: error, absurdity; to talk nonsense
entries.notes: M 栏第二词污损（T99），疑为西语 errores（谬误）旁注；主释义据其余可辨三栏。

entries.en: 〔manuscript damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏整栏残缺；H「渵」为罕见字、R 仅存 miâo，四栏互证不足，不敢定释。

entries.en: rash, reckless; to act rashly or foolishly
muddled, confused; to talk nonsense
entries.notes: M 栏中段残缺，其后西语残句 hāy algùn mahndo 难解；主释义据 H「糊」、M hôu、R hū 与词头 Disparatar。

entries.en: recklessly, absurdly; in disorder
absurd and perverse; contrary to reason
entries.notes: M 栏前段残缺仅存 …ūlē；R 对音 mīn tùi 与「謬戾」不合，词头 en la puerta 亦疑有讹；释义据 H 与 M 残存部分。

entries.zh: 无凭无据的话；说的话毫无价值（胡话）
entries.en: baseless talk; what he says is worth nothing, nonsense
entries.notes: 「城」疑为「成」之借音；词头小注 no vale nada lo q dice 与之相应。

entries.zh: 纷嚷；喧闹乱嚷（如疯子般）
entries.en: to clamor and shout confusedly; to rant like a madman

entries.zh: 三做；胡乱做事、做事荒唐
entries.en: to botch what one does; to work foolishly
entries.notes: 「三」义不明（或为记音字），据 M 栏 loquear 旁注及词头 Disparatar en lo q hace 定为胡乱做事。

entries.zh: 吐龙涎；信口胡言、涎沫横飞地乱说
entries.en: (lit. to spit the dragon's saliva) to spout wild nonsense
entries.notes: M 尾注难辨（gazaufin、Humay 等）、R 第三音 T99 污损；按词头 Disparatar 取「胡言乱语」义，字面「吐龙涎」。
